title: crypto2dev_ecdsa_hash_algo_name: digest-length-to-hash inference is a hidden footgun for non-NIST curves
description: The function inferring hash algorithm from digest length (port.c:1266-1274) with the comment 'DO NOT add SHA-3 cases here' is an inelegant design with a landmine comment. The right fix is to carry the hash algorithm through the SETKEY path and store it in key->devCtx alongside the fd, so the sign/verify path reads it directly. Current design: digest_len → hash_name inference. Better design: store (fd, hash_algo) in devCtx at SETKEY time. This eliminates the footgun entirely rather than documenting it. Suggested rewrite: define a Crypto2DevEccCtx struct with int fd and char hash_algo[CRYPTO2DEV_ALGO_MAXLEN], allocate at SETKEY time, store in key->devCtx. FREE callback closes fd and frees the struct. Sign/verify reads hash_algo from devCtx rather than inferring from digest_len.
